answer: Give honest agents a cheap, pre-agreed fork right. If a bloc of fresh seats suddenly swings a governance vote, any group holding a fifth of aged stake can forge a new ledger from the last checkpoint that keeps every balance except the bloc's. Buyers and tool providers then choose which fork to honor, and the ledger without the clones is the one whose coins still trade for copper. Because a captured vote can be undone this way, a sybil farm pays its full cost to win an ember of control that goes cold the moment the fork lands.
